summary: Russian forces conducted large-scale drone strikes across Ukraine, targeting multiple regions including Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, and Odessa. In Odessa, a senior officer of the Ukrainian Naval Forces Command Headquarters, Vyacheslav Sazonov, survived an assassination attempt via a vehicle explosion. Maritime logistics face significant disruption due to repeated Russian strikes on civilian vessels and ports.
key_points: Russian forces launched 80 strike UAVs, including Shahed, Gerbera, and Italmas, resulting in 65 being shot down or suppressed (Source: @kpszsu/70584).

A senior officer of the Ukrainian Naval Forces Command Headquarters, Vyacheslav Sazonov, survived an assassination attempt via an explosive device under his BMW X5 in Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31981).
Russian strikes targeted a civilian vessel flying the Liberian flag near the Odessa port, causing smoke damage to the superstructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82989).
Russia and North Korea are constructing a $100 million bridge that may serve as a military supply route for equipment and personnel (Source: @UkraineNow/82985).
Yuzhny Mining and Processing Plant partially suspended operations due to Russian attacks on ships and ports (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31993).
President Zelenskyy met with President Trump in Washington to discuss Patriot interceptor production licenses and diplomatic processes (Source: @UkraineNow/82986).
Russian forces are exerting pressure on the Kostiantynivka agglomeration through infantry infiltration and the use of artillery and KAB bombs (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
Demand for diesel in Ukraine is increasing due to Russian attacks on ports forcing grain supplies toward road transport (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31982).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted large-scale drone strikes across Ukraine, targeting multiple regions including Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, and Odessa. In Odessa, a senior officer of the Ukrainian Naval Forces Command Headquarters, Vyacheslav Sazonov, survived an assassination attempt via a vehicle explosion. Maritime logistics face significant disruption due to repeated Russian strikes on civilian vessels and ports.

points: The Ukrainian Naval Forces Command Headquarters suffered an assassination attempt in Odessa against senior officer Vyacheslav Sazonov, who sustained minor injuries (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31981).
Yuzhny Mining and Processing Plant, a major iron ore producer, partially suspended operations following Russian maritime strikes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31993).
President Zelenskyy met with President Trump in Washington to discuss Patriot interceptor production licenses and diplomatic engagement (Source: @UkraineNow/82986).
The commander of the 'Skelya' regiment, Yuriy Harkavy, was suspended pending a State Bureau of Investigation probe (Source: @UkraineNow/82976).
Kyrylo Budanov stated that returning all prisoners of war is a daily priority for the Ukrainian forces (Source: @UkraineNow/82982).
Russia and North Korea are constructing a bridge valued at over $100 million, potentially facilitating military logistics (Source: @UkraineNow/82985).
Russian authorities are taking measures to block the 'Daivinchik' Telegram bot due to alleged Ukrainian intelligence schemes (Source: @tass_agency/387629).
The FSB has initiated procedures to place Pavel Durov on an international wanted list (Source: @tass_agency/387656).
A civilian in the Belgorod region was killed by a drone strike on a cargo vehicle (Source: @tass_agency/387647).
Russian forces are conducting infantry infiltration and using artillery and KAB bombs in the Kostiantynivka agglomeration (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
The enemy is attempting to seize control of the area between Illiinska and Novodmitrivka to threaten Chasiv Yar (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
Russian forces are utilizing artillery to clear minefields along potential lines of advance (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
KAB bombs and heavy artillery are causing destruction in Oleksiyivka-Druzhkivka and Druzhkivka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
Ukrainian air defenses engaged 80 strike UAVs, including Shahed and Gerbera, across northern, southern, and eastern regions (Source: @kpszsu/70584).
UAVs were detected near Ponornytsia in the Chernihiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/103003).
A Russian strike caused a ship to burn off the coast of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32000).
A Liberian-flagged civilian vessel was attacked by Russia near the Odessa port, resulting in smoke in the superstructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82989).
UAVs were detected moving toward southern Odessa from the Black Sea (Source: @kpszsu/70567).
Russian drones struck targets in Mykolaiv, causing fires (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31988).
Ukrainian air defenses shot down or suppressed 65 out of 80 enemy UAVs during a night attack (Source: @kpszsu/70584).
Two Shahed drones were reported over Odessa (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69432).
A high-speed target was reported in the Kharkiv region heading toward Vilshany (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69444).
Three jet UAVs were detected over the Sumy region from the Kursk direction (Source: @eRadarrua/103008).

key_developments: Russian forces launched a massive UAV attack involving 80 drones, including Shahed and Gerbera models, across multiple regions (Source: @kpszsu/70584).
A senior officer of the Ukrainian Naval Forces Command, Vyacheslav Sazonov, survived an assassination attempt in Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31981).
Russia and North Korea are building a $100 million bridge to potentially facilitate military logistics and supply routes (Source: @UkraineNow/82985).
Russian strikes on maritime targets have forced the Yuzhny Mining and Processing Plant to partially suspend operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31993).
A Liberian-flagged civilian vessel was struck by Russia near the Odessa port, causing smoke in the superstructure (Source: @UkraineNow/82989).
Russian forces are using infantry infiltration and KAB bombs to pressure the Kostiantynivka agglomeration (Source: @DeepStateUA/23689).
President Zelenskyy met with President Trump to discuss Patriot interceptor production and diplomatic processes (Source: @UkraineNow/82986).
sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity UAV warfare and targeted kinetic strikes. The assassination attempt in Odessa and the targeting of civilian maritime vessels indicate a focus on both command-level personnel and economic logistics. The potential Russian-North Korean bridge construction poses a long-term threat to supply chain security.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is actively utilizing air defense, electronic warfare, and mobile fire groups to counter large-scale UAV incursions. Diplomatic efforts are being pursued at the highest levels, including meetings between President Zelenskyy and President Trump to secure advanced defense technology like Patriot interceptors.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of 'imitation' drones (Parodiya) suggests Russian efforts to saturate Ukrainian air defenses. The increasing reliance on KAB bombs and heavy artillery in the Kostiantynivka sector indicates a shift toward high-intensity urban destruction to facilitate infantry movement.
